description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for handling agent tool parameters, including normalization, validation, and schema patching, specifically for Claude Code conventions and tool parameter management.

methods.name: parameterValidationError
methods.description: Creates an Error object with a message appended by a retry guidance suffix.

methods.name: describeReceivedParamValue
methods.description: Provides a string description of a received parameter value for validation feedback.

methods.name: formatReceivedParamHint
methods.description: Formats a hint string showing received parameters based on validation groups.

methods.name: extractStructuredText
methods.description: Recursively extracts text content from structured data objects.

methods.name: normalizeTextLikeParam
methods.description: Normalizes structured text content into string form for specific keys.

methods.name: normalizeEditReplacement
methods.description: Normalizes an edit replacement object, ensuring required fields are strings.

methods.name: normalizeEditReplacements
methods.description: Normalizes all edit replacements in a record, converting oldText/newText fields into structured edits.

methods.name: hasValidEditReplacements
methods.description: Validates that all edits in a record are properly normalized.

methods.name: normalizeClaudeParamAliases
methods.description: Replaces alias keys with their original keys in parameter records.

methods.name: addClaudeParamAliasesToSchema
methods.description: Adds alias keys to schema properties and updates required fields accordingly.

methods.name: normalizeToolParams
methods.description: Normalizes tool parameters from Claude conventions to internal conventions, handling structured content.

methods.name: patchToolSchemaForClaudeCompatibility
methods.description: Modifies a tool's schema to be compatible with Claude parameter aliases.

methods.name: assertRequiredParams
methods.description: Checks for presence of required parameters based on validation groups, throws error if missing.

methods.name: wrapToolParamNormalization
methods.description: Wraps a tool's execute method to normalize parameters before execution, applying schema patches and validation.
